[FACT] User is looking to get a better mortgage deal for a home they are interested in purchasing.  
[FACT] User is working on paying off outstanding debts to improve their credit score.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Improving credit score by paying off debts can significantly impact the interest rate on a mortgage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should make a list of all outstanding debts, including balance, interest rate, minimum payment, and due date for each debt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should sort debts by interest rate, from highest to lowest.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should focus on paying off debts with interest rates above 15% first.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can consider using the debt snowball method to pay off debts with similar interest rates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should focus on debts that significantly impact their credit utilization ratio first.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can consolidate high-interest debts into a single loan with a lower interest rate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should try to pay more than the minimum payment on debts each month.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can use the 50/30/20 rule for budgeting: 50% for necessary expenses, 30% for discretionary spending, and 20% for debt repayment and savings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should identify areas to cut expenses and consider increasing income through side hustles or raises.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should regularly review their debt repayment progress to stay motivated.  
[FACT] Average 30-year fixed mortgage rate in the U.S. is around 4.25% to 4.5% as of 2023.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Excellent credit (760-850) can qualify for a 4.0% to 4.25% interest rate on a mortgage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Good credit (700-759) can qualify for a 4.25% to 4.5% interest rate on a mortgage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fair credit (680-699) can qualify for a 4.5% to 4.75% interest rate on a mortgage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Poor credit (620-679) can qualify for a 5.0% to 5.25% interest rate on a mortgage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bad credit (below 620) can qualify for a 5.5% to 6.0% interest rate or higher on a mortgage.
